experiment.name: hf_patchtst_revin_ohlc_global_volume_dirloss
experiment.description: Same as hf_patchtst_revin_ohlc_global_volume (RevIN OHLC + global log_volume_norm, volume included), plus an explicit directional loss term on top of the existing RevIN MSE -- tests whether that run's below-chance directional accuracy (a systematic wrong-sign bias, not just noise) can be corrected without dropping volume.

loss_weights.note: unweighted MSE + DIR_LOSS_WEIGHT * directional_loss, see intro markdown
